tools.name: snapshot
tools.description: Today's tide on every asset under the rule: crypto breadth and the Core 30 by state (tide in, slack water, tide out), the flips on the newest completed candle, the current Sunday Tide Report, and one row per asset with band, direction, close, the Tideline, distance from it in ATR and percent, candle

tools.name: asset
tools.description: One asset by id, symbol or name (btc, BTC, Bitcoin): its state on the last completed daily and weekly candle, the room to its line, the record of every daily trip since its replay (trips, losing share, average win and loss, best, worst, the rule against holding) and its most recent flips, with the p

tools.name: report
tools.description: One Sunday Tide Report from the public archive (every ISO week since 2025-W01): how many of the 140 crypto assets were tide in, slack or out on the candles completed by that Sunday, the Core 30, the week's flips, the leaders, the assets in slack water and the ledger hash of the day. tools.name: rule
tools.description: The rule manifest behind every state and flip: Supertrend parameters, ATR method, candle definitions, data sources per asset class, the schedule, record types, the changelog and the manifest hash.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search assets, reports and pages. Returns ids for fetch: snapshot, snapshot:W, asset:<id>, report:<week>, rule, page:<path>.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Fetch one document by id from search: snapshot (today's market, daily), snapshot:W (weekly), asset:<id>, report:<week> or report:latest, rule, page:<path>.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
